article_context: 研究人员让真实老鼠与社交型、非社交型机器人共同生活，发现老鼠更愿意帮助曾与自己互动的社交机器人，说明简单的行为线索也足以触发社会性回应。

article.title: 阅读 Text 1 · 老鼠会把社交机器人当成伙伴吗
article.background: 研究人员让真实老鼠与社交型、非社交型机器人共同生活，发现老鼠更愿意帮助曾与自己互动的社交机器人，说明简单的行为线索也足以触发社会性回应。

sentences.en: Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid.
sentences.zh: 老鼠和其他动物需要对同类发出的社会信号高度敏锐，才能识别可以合作的朋友和应当避开的敌人。

segments.text: Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid.

sentences.en: To find out if this extends to non-living beings, Laleh Quinn at the University of California, San Diego, and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect social signals from robotic rats.
sentences.zh: 为了弄清这种能力是否也会延伸到非生命体，加州大学圣迭戈分校的拉莱·奎因及其同事测试了老鼠能否识别机器鼠发出的社会信号。

segments.text: To find out if this extends to non-living beings, Laleh Quinn at the University of California, San Diego, and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect social signals from robotic rats.

sentences.en: They housed eight adult rats with two types of robotic rat—one social and one asocial—for four days.
sentences.zh: 他们让八只成年老鼠与两种机器鼠共同生活了四天：一种具有社交行为，另一种则没有。

segments.text: They housed eight adult rats with two types of robotic rat—one social and one asocial—for four days.

sentences.en: The robot rats were quite minimalist, resembling a chunkier version of a computer mouse with wheels to move around and colourful markings.
sentences.zh: 这些机器鼠的设计相当极简，看起来像更厚实的电脑鼠标，装有轮子可以移动，并带有彩色标记。

segments.text: The robot rats were quite minimalist, resembling a chunkier version of a computer mouse with wheels to move around and colourful markings.

sentences.en: During the experiment, the social robot rat followed the living rats around, played with the same toys, and opened cage doors to let trapped rats escape.
sentences.zh: 实验期间，社交型机器鼠会跟随真实老鼠活动，和它们玩同样的玩具，还会打开笼门放出被困的老鼠。

segments.text: During the experiment, the social robot rat followed the living rats around, played with the same toys, and opened cage doors to let trapped rats escape.

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the asocial robot simply moved forwards and backwards and side to side.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，非社交型机器鼠只会前后、左右移动。

segments.text: Meanwhile, the asocial robot simply moved forwards and backwards and side to side.

sentences.en: Next, the researchers trapped the robots in cages and gave the rats the opportunity to release them by pressing a lever.
sentences.zh: 接着，研究人员把机器鼠关进笼子，并让真实老鼠有机会通过按下杠杆将它们放出。

segments.text: Next, the researchers trapped the robots in cages and gave the rats the opportunity to release them by pressing a lever.

sentences.en: Across 18 trials each, the living rats were 52 per cent more likely on average to set the social robot free than the asocial one.
sentences.zh: 在每种条件各18次试验中，真实老鼠释放社交型机器鼠的平均可能性比释放非社交型机器鼠高52%。

segments.text: Across 18 trials each, the living rats were 52 per cent more likely on average to set the social robot free than the asocial one.

sentences.en: This suggests that the rats perceived the social robot as a genuine social being.
sentences.zh: 这表明，老鼠把社交型机器鼠视为真正的社会性存在。

segments.text: This suggests that the rats perceived the social robot as a genuine social being.

sentences.en: They may have bonded more with the social robot because it displayed behaviors like communal exploring and playing.
sentences.zh: 它们可能与社交型机器鼠建立了更强的联系，因为后者表现出了共同探索、一起玩耍等行为。

segments.text: They may have bonded more with the social robot because it displayed behaviors like communal exploring and playing.

sentences.en: This could lead to the rats better remembering having freed it earlier, and wanting the robot to return the favour when they get trapped, says Quinn.
sentences.zh: 奎因说，这可能使老鼠更清楚地记得自己先前曾救过它，并期待自己被困时机器鼠也能回报这一帮助。

segments.text: This could lead to the rats better remembering having freed it earlier, and wanting the robot to return the favour when they get trapped, says Quinn.

sentences.en: “Rats have been shown to engage in multiple forms of reciprocal help and cooperation, including what is referred to as direct reciprocity—where a rat will help another rat that has previously helped them,” says Quinn.
sentences.zh: 奎因说：“研究已经证明，老鼠会进行多种形式的互惠帮助与合作，其中包括所谓的直接互惠——一只老鼠会帮助此前帮助过自己的另一只老鼠。”

segments.text: “Rats have been shown to engage in multiple forms of reciprocal help and cooperation, including what is referred to as direct reciprocity—where a rat will help another rat that has previously helped them,” says Quinn.

sentences.en: The readiness of the rats to befriend the social robot was surprising given its minimal design.
sentences.zh: 考虑到机器鼠设计如此简单，真实老鼠竟如此愿意与社交型机器鼠建立关系，令人意外。

segments.text: The readiness of the rats to befriend the social robot was surprising given its minimal design.

sentences.en: The robot was the same size as a regular rat but resembled a simple plastic box on wheels.
sentences.zh: 这台机器人与普通老鼠大小相当，却只是一个装着轮子的简单塑料盒。

segments.text: The robot was the same size as a regular rat but resembled a simple plastic box on wheels.

sentences.en: “We'd assumed we'd have to give it a moving head and tail, facial features, and put a scent on it to make it smell like a real rat, but that wasn't necessary,” says Janet Wiles at the University of Queensland in Australia, who helped with the research.
sentences.zh: 参与研究的澳大利亚昆士兰大学珍妮特·怀尔斯说：“我们原以为必须给它装上会动的头和尾巴、面部特征，还要加上气味，让它闻起来像真老鼠，但事实证明没有必要。”

segments.text: “We'd assumed we'd have to give it a moving head and tail, facial features, and put a scent on it to make it smell like a real rat, but that wasn't necessary,” says Janet Wiles at the University of Queensland in Australia, who helped with the research.

sentences.en: The finding shows how sensitive rats are to social cues, even when they come from basic robots.
sentences.zh: 这一发现表明，老鼠对社会性线索十分敏感，即便这些线索来自最简单的机器人。

segments.text: The finding shows how sensitive rats are to social cues, even when they come from basic robots.

sentences.en: Similarly, children tend to treat robots as if they are fellow beings, even when they display only simple social signals.
sentences.zh: 类似地，即使机器人只表现出简单的社会信号，儿童也往往会把它们当作同伴来对待。

segments.text: Similarly, children tend to treat robots as if they are fellow beings, even when they display only simple social signals.

sentences.en: “We humans seem to be fascinated by robots, and it turns out other animals are too,” says Wiles.
sentences.zh: 怀尔斯说：“我们人类似乎会被机器人吸引，而事实证明，其他动物也是如此。”

segments.text: “We humans seem to be fascinated by robots, and it turns out other animals are too,” says Wiles.
